director_notes.visual_style: Shot on 35mm stock with fine organic grain and delicate highlight halation. The palette centers on muted slate-grey tones accented by warm 3200K amber practical highlights, maintaining lifted filmic shadows and a restrained, desaturated dramatic register.
director_notes.camera_style: Deliberate eye-level framing with locked static holds and imperceptible linear push-ins only. Utilizes 35mm anamorphic lenses for balanced wide shots and 85mm prime lenses with shallow depth-of-field for intimate subject focus, strictly prohibiting rapid whipping or handheld camera jitter.
director_notes.lighting: Motivated directional side-lighting clashing with cool 5600K ambient daylight falloff. Subdued volumetric haze captures subtle light shafts, producing rich mid-tone contrast and soft, deep shadow gradients without digital noise.
director_notes.editing: Contemplative pacing structured into 5-to-6 second scene holds across the 30-second duration. Hard cuts executed on subtle subject micro-actions, allowing visual and emotional tension to linger without abrupt transitions.
director_notes.music: 62 BPM, somber and yearning mood, solo bowed cello paired with warm felt piano and low analog synth drones, sparse minimalist texture building into a restrained, resonant climax.
director_notes.style_lock: Cinematic prestige drama, muted slate-grey and amber 3200K palette, directional motivated side-light with soft volumetric haze, 35mm anamorphic grain with subtle halation, photorealistic tactile textures.
avoid: fast chaotic motion or rapid whip pans
morphing facial features or shifting anatomical proportions
extra fingers, deformed limbs, or distorted anatomy
sudden changes in wardrobe style or clothing color between frames
bright saturated cartoon or hyper-vivid neon colors
blown-out overexposed highlights and noisy crushed blacks
on-screen text, watermarks, subtitles, or ui logos inside the video frame
unstable handheld camera shake and rapid digital zooms
unwanted additional characters appearing in frame
